deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

plum-velvet.$description: Plum Velvet — Navigation text, secondary headings, card titles, footer copy — slightly lighter companion to Deep Iris

royal-amethyst.$description: Royal Amethyst — Links, input focus rings, accent strokes, icon highlights — the most saturated violet

mist-violet.$description: Mist Violet — Soft highlight washes, tinted section backgrounds, decorative blurs — the lavender atmosphere

lavender-wash.$description: Lavender Wash — Decorative gradient stops and hero atmosphere

twilight-beam.$description: Twilight Beam — Multi-stop decorative gradient for hero glow effects

canvas.$description: Canvas — Page background, card surfaces, input fields, button text on dark fills

paper.$description: Paper — Subtle surface lift, table row alternation, secondary card backgrounds

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders, dividers, subtle separators

smoke.$description: Smoke — Disabled states, skeleton placeholders, muted background blocks

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, placeholder copy, secondary metadata

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary body text, descriptions, table metadata

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body text, link text, icon strokes in neutral contexts

carbon.$description: Carbon — Dark UI elements, near-black accents

ink.$description: Ink — Maximum contrast text and borders in specific dark UI elements

britti-sans.$description: Display and heading typeface used exclusively at 24–64px, always weight 500. The 1.0 line-height is distinctive — headings sit tight with no leading slack, creating geometric, almost architectural presence. Substitute with Plus Jakarta Sans (500) or General Sans (500) for closest geometric match.

inter.$description: Workhorse UI and body typeface. Weight 400 for body, 500 for buttons/nav/table headers, 700 for emphasized labels. The tight size range (12–16px) and compact line-heights signal a data-dense product, not a marketing site. Substitute with Inter directly or IBM Plex Sans.
